verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ عَلَى «ذَوَاتِ ٱلْأَوْتَارِ». مَزْمُورٌ. تَسْبِيحَةٌ لِيَتَحَنَّنِ ٱللهُ عَلَيْنَا وَلْيُبَارِكْنَا. لِيُنِرْ بِوَجْهِهِ عَلَيْنَا. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm [or] Song. God be merciful unto us, and bless us; [and] cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.
verses.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֥ח בִּנְגִינֹ֗ת מִזְמֹ֥ור שִֽׁיר׃ אֱלֹהִ֗ים יְחָנֵּ֥נוּ וִֽיבָרְכֵ֑נוּ יָ֤אֵ֥ר פָּנָ֖יו אִתָּ֣נוּ סֶֽלָה׃

verses.ar: لِكَيْ يُعْرَفَ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ طَرِيقُكَ، وَفِي كُلِّ ٱلْأُمَمِ خَلَاصُكَ.
verses.kjv: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.
verses.web: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,

verses.ar: يَحْمَدُكَ ٱلشُّعُوبُ يَا ٱللهُ. يَحْمَدُكَ ٱلشُّعُوبُ كُلُّهُمْ.
verses.kjv: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
verses.web: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
verses.he: יֹוד֖וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים ׀ אֱלֹהִ֑ים יֹ֝וד֗וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם׃

verses.ar: تَفْرَحُ وَتَبْتَهِجُ ٱلْأُمَمُ لِأَنَّكَ تَدِينُ ٱلشُّعُوبَ بِٱلِٱسْتِقَامَةِ، وَأُمَمَ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَهْدِيهِمْ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.
verses.web: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.
verses.he: יִֽשְׂמְח֥וּ וִֽירַנְּנ֗וּ לְאֻ֫מִּ֥ים כִּֽי־תִשְׁפֹּ֣ט עַמִּ֣ים מִישֹׁ֑ור וּלְאֻמִּ֓ים ׀ בָּאָ֖רֶץ תַּנְחֵ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃

verses.ar: يَحْمَدُكَ ٱلشُّعُوبُ يَا ٱللهُ. يَحْمَدُكَ ٱلشُّعُوبُ كُلُّهُمْ.
verses.kjv: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
verses.web: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
verses.he: יֹוד֖וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים ׀ אֱלֹהִ֑ים יֹ֝וד֗וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם׃

verses.ar: ٱلْأَرْضُ أَعْطَتْ غَلَّتَهَا. يُبَارِكُنَا ٱللهُ إِلَهُنَا.
verses.kjv: [Then] shall the earth yield her increase; [and] God, [even] our own God, shall bless us.
verses.web: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.
verses.he: אֶ֭רֶץ נָתְנָ֣ה יְבוּלָ֑הּ יְ֝בָרְכֵ֗נוּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

verses.ar: يُبَارِكُنَا ٱللهُ، وَتَخْشَاهُ كُلُّ أَقَاصِي ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
verses.web: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.
